stem: Which description correctly follows light through the pupil?
choices: The pupil bends light and the iris detects it.
Light passes through the opening in the iris and then through the crystalline lens.
Light reaches the retina before reaching the crystalline lens.
The pupil produces the nerve signal sent to the brain.
explanation: The pupil is an opening in the iris. The lens behind it helps focus light onto the retina, where it is converted into signals.

source.title: National Eye Institute · How the Eyes Work

stem: A wearer looks 3 mm above the optical center of a spherical minus lens. Which way is the prism base at the pupil mark?
choices: Up
Down
In
Out
explanation: The minus lens has its base away from the optical center. The pupil mark is above the center, so the base points up. The horizontal directions cannot describe this displacement.

stem: A −5.00 D spherical spectacle lens has its optical center 4 mm below the pupil. What prism does the wearer experience at the pupil?
choices: 20Δ base up
2Δ base down
2Δ base up
0.2Δ base down
explanation: Convert 4 mm to 0.4 cm. Multiplying 0.4 by 5 gives 2Δ. The pupil is above the center, and a minus lens has its base away from that center. The result is base up.

stem: A new reusable soft lens wearer says they will add fresh multipurpose solution to yesterday’s solution. What should the optician ask the wearer to demonstrate?
choices: Filtering the old solution before adding fresh solution
Using sterile saline as the overnight disinfectant
Adding fresh solution until the lens floats
Discarding used solution and following the labeled cleaning and disinfection steps with fresh solution
explanation: Used solution must be discarded. Topping off can reduce disinfection effectiveness. Saline can rinse when indicated but does not disinfect. A repeat demonstration checks understanding.

source.title: FDA · Contact Lens Solutions and Products

stem: A contact lens wearer reports light sensitivity. At follow-up, the clinician measures reduced right-eye acuity. Which entry belongs under objective findings?
choices: The wearer says sunlight hurts
The measured change in right-eye acuity
The wearer reports that the eye feels gritty
The wearer remembers symptoms beginning this morning
explanation: The acuity measurement is an examination finding. Light sensitivity, grittiness and recalled onset are reported by the wearer.

stem: A reusable contact lens wearer reports new eye pain, redness and worsening vision while wearing the lens. Which action is appropriate?
choices: Replace the lens and reassess next week
Continue wear with more rewetting drops
Remove the lens and contact an eye care professional immediately
Reduce the wearing time by one hour each day
explanation: These warning signs need prompt professional assessment. Continued wear, a replacement lens or delayed review could postpone necessary care.

stem: An anterior-segment OCT scan shows fluid above the corneal apex and local tissue compression beneath the peripheral scleral lens. Which feature explains the peripheral finding?
choices: Central corneal thickness
Tear film break-up time
Lens back vertex power
Landing-zone alignment
explanation: The lens rests on the conjunctiva over the sclera at the landing zone. Central clearance describes the reservoir over the cornea. It cannot rule out peripheral compression.

source.title: GP Lens Institute and Scleral Lens Education Society · Troubleshooting guide

stem: A rigid lens matches the ordered central back radius. Which inspection specifically evaluates the blend between its back peripheral curves?
choices: Trace a reflected line of white light across the junction under magnification
Repeat center thickness with a thickness gauge
Read back vertex power in a lensometer
Measure overall diameter in a V-groove gauge
explanation: The reflected line changes as it crosses curvature transitions. Inspecting that reflex helps reveal an abrupt junction. Thickness, power and diameter measurements describe different properties.

source.title: Spors and colleagues · Verification and inspection of rigid contact lenses
